en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Musa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Every intoxicant is Prohibited, and every brewing is Prohibited, and the fermented drinks are Prohibited’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Musa from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
All intoxicating substances are unlawful, everything confusing the power of reason is unlawful and al-Fuqa’ (beer) is unlawful.’”
